name: Kobayakawa Shiho
source: New English teacher at Kamijou Gakuen and the student council advisor. A bit natural, usually she is very relaxed, but sometimes she will unsuspectingly show her plump figure. She was previously the protagonist's tutor, and due to certain events they banged each other like animals. After that they have never again contacted one another, their fateful meeting at school is entirely coincidental. She doesn't care about the people around them, and will actively try to flirt with the protagonist by making body contact. Likes classical music and is obsessed with the piano. Her cooking is very bad.
